room_rent.note: Policy wording does not specify a room rent cap; shared accommodation benefit waives non-medical expense exclusion if shared room chosen at network hospital

icu.note: ICU covered under in-patient treatment but no specific cap mentioned

copayment.note: 20% co-pay applies only if opted and mentioned in policy schedule; no mandatory co-pay by default. No co-pay if Tier 2 insured treats in Tier 1.

sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; HbA1C checkup benefit capped at ₹750 per claim (max 2/year). No other disease-wise sub-limits stated.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period implied; Diabetes (Type1/Type2, IFG, IGT) and Hypertension covered from day 1

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period 24 months; Diabetes (T1/T2, IFG, IGT) and Hypertension explicitly excluded from PED waiting

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, eye, benign tumours etc.) excluded for 24 months

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under Standard Exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added each claim-free renewal; max 100% of base SI; irrespective of claims

restoration.note: Restore benefit: 100% of basic SI restored once per policy year on complete or partial utilisation; single claim cannot exceed basic SI + cumulative bonus; restored SI usable for all in-patient claims

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in policy

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered in AYUSH Hospital; OPD AYUSH not covered

organ_donor.note: Harvesting surgery costs covered; donor pre/post-hospitalisation excluded

modern_treatments.note: No explicit mention of modern/robotic surgery cover in policy wording

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded per Annexure I

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only

notable_exclusions: Maternity, OPD treatment, treatment outside India, pancreatic islet transplant, stem cell harvesting, dental (unless hospitalised), congenital external anomalies, sleep apnoea investigation
optional_riders: Optional 20% co-payment (reduces premium); Wellness Programme with premium discount up to 25% on renewal
